_meta.game: Zeliard (Game Arts 1987 / Sierra On-Line 1990, MS-DOS English release)
_meta.purpose: The seven hero spells: acquisition, charges, damage, projectile behaviour, refills.

units.frame: One main cavern-loop iteration (200FIGHT game_loop_render_and_timing). Length = speed_const*4 PIT ticks at 236.70 Hz; default speed_const 5 (F9 digit 5) => 20 ticks = 84.5 ms (11.83 frames/s). F9 digit d sets speed_const = 10-d.
units.tile: Map cell. The cavern 'proximity map' around the hero is 36 columns x 64 rows; the visible viewport is 28 x 19 tiles. Hero occupies 3x3 tiles.

sources: research/zeliard-expanded/extracted/zeliard-main/3_Assembly/ida/fight.asm (IDA-annotated 200FIGHT): magic_spell_fire_handler, init_magic_projectile, init_rascar, init_agua, init_guerra, espada_move, saeta_move, fuego_move, rascar_move, agua_move, monster_is_in_spawn_range_and_clear, mark_proximity_monster_as_spell_target, Get_Stats, byte_98BE
3_Assembly/masm/working/zelres2/code/217KENJP.asm + tasm/bin/zelres2/217KENJP.bin (sage texts, spell-grant opcodes 07h..0Dh, per-level charge table at DS:A380)
Community: 4_Resources/GameData/GAME_DATA_REFERENCE.md, manuals/text/Zeliard_ Magical Items and Spells.txt

save_bytes.learned_flags: player record 0xBB..0xC1 (00 = not learned, FF = learned)
save_bytes.note: ida/common.inc labels 0xAB as 'spells_espada default' and 0xB4 as 'espada_count'; the code proves 0xAB..0xB1 is the CURRENT count (decremented by magic_spell_fire_handler) and 0xB4..0xBA the MAX (church/inn/Chikara copy 0xB4.. -> 0xAB..). masm stdply.inc agrees.

casting.key: ALT (the 'magic' button). A spell must be selected in the inventory (0x9D != 0).
blocked_when: a previous spell effect is still active (flag FF3E) - only one spell effect can exist at a time
selected spell has 0 charges (animation plays, nothing fires)
casting.timeline: Cast animation counter 9F2B += 2 each frame: frame 1 value 2, frame 2 value 4 -> charge is decremented and the projectile(s) spawn; frame 3 value 6 -> cast pose ends. So the projectile appears on the 2nd frame after pressing ALT.
casting.spawn_point: Single projectiles spawn at the hero's head row (+1 row when crouching), 4 or 5 columns right of the hero's left edge depending on facing, travelling in the facing direction.
casting.hit_test: Each frame every live projectile tests the 3x3 tile block centred on it (monster_is_in_spawn_range_and_clear). Any monster cell found gets ai_flags = 0x40 | (spell_number+1) unless it is already flagged 'being hit' (bit 0x20) or is an object; the monster's own AI then calls Hero_Hits_monster. Projectiles only hit inside window columns 2..33 of the 36-wide proximity map.
casting.damage: Hero_Hits_monster -> Get_Stats(al = spell_number+1) -> fixed table byte_98BE = [2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 255] for spells 1..7. Spell damage does NOT scale with level, sword or Sabre Oil. Monster HP is one byte; hp <= damage kills.
casting.bosses: In boss caverns a projectile that reaches the boss while boss_being_hit is set does nothing; boss chunks apply their own multipliers/dividers to spell damage (see bosses.json).

acquisition.rule: Spells are taught by Sages on the FIRST visit (intro speech, one-time; 'sages_spoken_to_hero' bitmask at 0xE5). The intro script's opcode 07h..0Dh sets learned flag 0xBA+n to FF and makes it the selected spell (0x9D = n). Learning does not change charges.
acquisition.note: Marid (Muralla) teaches nothing. Esco has no Sage.

per_level_max._source: 217KENJP.bin DS:A380, 16 rows x 9 bytes [HP word, 7 charge bytes], row index = level BEFORE the level-up
per_level_max.17_plus: each level-up from level 16 upward adds +2 to every max (saturating at 255)

refills.effect: max charges set from the table above and current charges set equal to max (full refill). No refill if the Sage does not raise your level.
current = max for all 7 (and HP = max)
refills.evidence: 214CHURP.bin: mov si,00B4 / mov di,00AB / mov cx,7 / rep movsb

refills.effect: current = max for all 7 (and HP = max)
current = max for the SELECTED spell only; no effect if no spell selected

charges.community_exploit_confirmed_by_code: Paguro trick: use Agua charges before the next level-up; the level-up refill restores them (level-up always refills).

spells.name: Espada
spells.sage_description: the Magic Spell of Throwing Swords: Espada.
spells.behaviour: Straight horizontal throw in the facing direction at 2 tiles/frame, animated 3-frame cycle. Lives 5 frames (about 10 tiles). Stops (sets return/deactivate bit 0x80 in mp_dir) on the first frame it hits a monster.
evidence: ida/fight.asm espada_move: life_timer < 5; on hit 'or mp_dir,80h'

spells.name: Saeta
spells.sage_description: the Magic Spell of Arrows: Saeta.
spells.behaviour: Straight horizontal arrow, 2 tiles/frame, lives 10 frames (about 20 tiles). Does not stop on hit: damages every monster it passes (each monster once per hit window).
evidence: ida/fight.asm saeta_move: life_timer < 0Ah, no deactivate on hit
spells.community: good range; 'useful for breaking walls' (community claim, not verified in the projectile code - walls are map objects hit via the same monster-cell test)

spells.name: Fuego
spells.sage_description: the Magic Spell of Fire: Fuego.
spells.behaviour: Frames 1-3: flies forward 2 tiles/frame (no animation). From frame 4 it stops moving horizontally, animates (4-frame cycle) and drops 1 row per frame while the two tiles two rows below are passable, i.e. falls to the floor and burns in place. Lives 12 frames total (~1 s). Hits everything overlapping its 3x3 area every frame it is alive.
evidence: ida/fight.asm fuego_move: life < 0Ch; life < 4 -> move; else fall if is_non_blocking_tile(di+72) and (di+73)
spells.community: fire that burns on ground, short range; needed vs slimes

spells.name: Lanzar
spells.sage_description: the Magic Spell of Flame: Lanzar.
spells.behaviour: Identical movement to Saeta (uses saeta_move): straight, 2 tiles/frame, 10 frames, piercing. Different graphics and 4x Saeta's damage.

spells.name: Rascar
spells.sage_description: the Magic Spell of Falling Rocks: Rascar.
spells.behaviour: Four rocks spawn above the top of the screen at proximity-map columns 8, 14, 20 and 26 (6*i+2 for i=1..4, i.e. spread across the whole view regardless of facing), each starting 3..6 rows above the viewport top (random 0..3 extra). All fall 2 rows per frame for 11 frames (22 rows) and ignore walls. Each rock hits monsters in its 3x3 area.
evidence: rascar_move: y += 2 for 4 rocks while life < 0Ch

spells.name: Agua
spells.sage_description: the Magic Spell of Water: Agua.
spells.behaviour: Three parallel horizontal jets spawned like a normal projectile but at rows y-2, y, y+2 (a 7-row-tall wave). All move 2 tiles/frame for 10 frames and pierce.
spells.community: powerful, kills most enemies in 1 hit; 'Agua evaporates' vs Dragon (boss-side rule, see bosses.json)

spells.name: Guerra
spells.sage_description: the Magic Spell of Lightning: Guerra.
spells.behaviour: Instant screen-wide lightning: on the firing frame every monster cell in a 36 x 19 block starting one row above the viewport is marked as hit by spell 7 (each monster once). Screen flashes (9EED/9EEE), sound 19h, no projectile persists. In a boss cavern it does nothing if the boss is currently in its 'being hit' state.
evidence: ida/fight.asm init_guerra: rows_19 x columns_36 loop calling mark_proximity_monster_as_spell_target
spells.community: lightning in all directions, ultimate spell

conflicts.code: stdply.bin 4 at level 0; the level-up table raises it to 8 from level 1
conflicts.chosen: both are true: 4 at level 0, 8 after the first level-up

gaps: Spell projectile sprite graphics come from the MPPx.GRP chunks selected by mdt_descriptor.mpp_grp_idx; tile layouts are in 200FIGHT sequences0/sequences1 tables (not transcribed here).
Per-enemy spell immunities (e.g. slimes vs fire) are implemented inside each EAI handler; see enemies.json.
